title: Pochettino Names USMNT 26-Man World Cup Squad with Pulisic Leading Host Nation
detail: Mauricio Pochettino announced the United States men's national team's final 26-man roster for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, with captain Christian Pulisic headlining the squad as the host nation prepares for the tournament. The announcement marks a milestone for American soccer as the US co-hosts the competition alongside Canada and Mexico.
